metadata.name: West Altadena danger zones
metadata.label: Forecast from live wind, not a prediction of this fire
metadata.generator: scripts/danger_zones.py (ensemble of the scenario's ground-aware spread model under NWS wind)
metadata.assumptions: Each member is the scenario's spread model (rollcall_d/urban_spread.py over rollcall_d/fire_ground.py: washes never burn, roads and open space slow it, embers cross) with its wind walking around that member's heading and speed. Members scatter around the forecast wind with 20 degrees of direction error and 25% speed error.
